rows.note: Use 懷疑 as the all-purpose noun for suspicion or doubt.

example.english: I have some suspicion about what he said.
example.jyutping: ngo5 deoi3 keoi5 gong2 ge3 je5 jau5 waai4 ji4

rows.note: Pick 嫌疑 for suspicion that someone may have committed wrongdoing, especially in a legal or investigative context.

example.english: The police have not yet ruled out their suspicion that they were involved.
example.traditional: 警方暫時未能排除佢嘅嫌疑。
example.jyutping: ging2 fong1 zaam6 si4 mei6 nang4 paai4 ceoi4 keoi5 ge3 jim4 ji4

rows.note: Pick 疑心 when the doubt involves personal mistrust or a lingering suspicion.

example.english: Don't let suspicion get the better of you; I'm not lying to you.
example.traditional: 你唔好咁重疑心，我冇呃你。
example.jyutping: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 zung6 ji4 sam1 ngo5 mou5 aak1 nei5

rows.note: Use 跡象 for an observable trace or slight indication, such as a sign of a smile.

example.english: There was a slight suspicion that she was about to smile.
example.traditional: 佢面上有一絲想笑嘅跡象。
example.jyutping: keoi5 min6 soeng6 jau5 jat1 si1 soeng2 siu3 ge3 zik1 zoeng6
